Module org.slb4j
Package org.slb4j

Class LoggingConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.slb4j.LoggingConfiguration
public final class LoggingConfiguration extends Object
A configuration class for setting up and managing logging behaviors and settings. This class provides methods and properties for configuring log handlers, log filters, and other logging-related functionalities.

    • LOGGER_CONSOLE_COLORED

      public static final String LOGGER_CONSOLE_COLORED
      Constant representing the configuration key used to specify whether console logging should include colored output for better readability.

      Valid values are "true", "false", and "auto".

      "auto" will evaluate to "true" if the JVM is connected to a terminal, otherwise "false".

  • Method Details

    • setRootFilter

      public void setRootFilter(LoggerNamePrefixFilter filter)
      Sets the root filter for the logging configuration. The root filter is a special filter applied to all loggers in the hierarchy.
      Parameters:
      filter - the LoggerNamePrefixFilter instance to set as the root filter; determines the filtering behavior for log entries with no specific logger name; must not be null.

    • getRootLevel

      public LogLevel getRootLevel()
      Retrieves the root log level of the logging configuration. The root log level determines the minimum severity of log messages that are processed by the root filter of the logging system.
      Returns:
      the LogLevel representing the current root log level configured in the logging system.

    • getHandlers

      public Map<String,LogHandler> getHandlers()
      Retrieves an unmodifiable SequencedCollection of all registered log handlers.
      Returns:
      a sequenced collection containing all LogHandler instances currently registered

    • getFilters

      public SequencedCollection<LogFilter> getFilters()
      Retrieves an unmodifiable SequencedCollection of all registered log filters.
      Returns:
      a sequenced collection containing all LogFilter instances currently registered

    • load

      public static LoggingConfiguration load()
      Automatically loads the logging configuration from the classpath.

      The method checks for the filenames defined in CONFIG_PARSERS and tries to load and parse the corresponding properties file. If none of the files are found or can be loaded, the default configuration is returned.

      Returns:
      the loaded LoggingConfiguration or defaultConfiguration() if none could be loaded.

      public String toString()
      Overrides:

    • getRootFilter

      public LoggerNamePrefixFilter getRootFilter()
      Retrieves the logger filter for the logging configuration. The logger filter is responsible for controlling the logging behavior based on logger name and defined log level rules.
      Returns:
      the LoggerNamePrefixFilter instance associated with the configuration, or null if no logger filter has been set.

    • setLoggerFilter

      public void setLoggerFilter(LoggerNamePrefixFilter rootFilter)
      Sets the logger filter for the logging configuration. The logger filter determines which log entries are allowed based on the logger name prefixes and log levels.
      Parameters:
      rootFilter - the LoggerNamePrefixFilter instance to set as the logger filter; can be customized to define filtering behavior, must not be null.

    • getHandler

      public @Nullable LogHandler getHandler(String name)
      Retrieves a log handler by its name.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the log handler to retrieve; must not be null
      Returns:
      the LogHandler associated with the provided name, or null if no handler is found

    • addHandler

      public @Nullable LogHandler addHandler(String name, LogHandler handler)
      Registers a new log handler or replaces an existing one in the current logging configuration.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the log handler to add or replace; must be non-null and non-empty
      handler - the LogHandler instance to be added or replaced; must not be null
      Returns:
      the previously registered LogHandler associated with the given name, or null if no handler was previously registered with that name

    • defaultConfiguration

      public static LoggingConfiguration defaultConfiguration()
      Creates a default logging configuration with predefined settings. The default configuration includes a root log filter set to the INFO log level and a console log handler for outputting log messages to the system output.
      Returns:
      a LoggingConfiguration instance with default filters and handlers applied

    • setRootLevel

      public void setRootLevel(LogLevel logLevel)
      Sets the root log level for the logging configuration. This determines the minimum log level that will be processed by the root filter of the logging system.
      Parameters:
      logLevel - the LogLevel to set as the root level; determines the threshold for which log messages are allowed

    • copyOf

      public static LoggingConfiguration copyOf(LoggingConfiguration other)
      Creates a copy of the provided logging configuration.

      The new configuration will have its own copies of the logger filter, handlers map, and filters map. Note that the log handlers themselves are NOT copied, as they represent active resources (like open files or streams).

      Parameters:
      other - the logging configuration to copy; must not be null
      Returns:
      a new LoggingConfiguration instance that is a copy of the provided one
